parameters.name: Attribute Class
parameters.description: Which attribute type to pass from the remaining inputs (first input always passes all).

parameters.name: Length Mismatch
parameters.description: Notification action when input POPs have different point counts.

parameters.name: Length Mismatch Action
parameters.description: What to do with attribute values when sampling outside input range: hold last values, set to 0, set to 1, or do nothing.

parameters.name: Duplicate Attributes
options: Only Replace Attribs of First Input
parameters.description: How to handle attribute name conflicts between inputs.

parameters.name: In POP(s)
parameters.description: Specify one or more POPs using pattern matching for this input block.

parameters.name: In Attributes
parameters.description: Selected attributes for this input block. Use pattern matching.

parameters.name: Rename to
parameters.description: Rename the input attributes to a new name.

troubleshooting: Length mismatch: shorter inputs may have repeated last values — use Length Mismatch Action to control
Duplicate attributes: Auto-Rename appends incrementing numbers to conflicting names
First input always passes ALL its attributes to output — subsequent inputs use Attribute Class filter
Use In POP(s) pattern matching (e.g., grid*) to select multiple operators at once
description: Takes multiple POP inputs and merges their attributes by name or pattern matching. For each input, select which attributes to include and optionally rename them. Handles duplicate attributes with auto-rename, keep first/last, or replace. Supports Point, Vertex, or Primitive attribute classes. Also handles length mismatches between inputs.
